name: Nichinan (Miyazaki, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nichinan city emblem in red: a ring with four pointed rays enclosing a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Nichinan, a city in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 2 November 2009.

features.role: Nichinan city emblem — a ring with four pointed rays enclosing a disc
